helpSubtitle: Standard protocol for community health workers and rural screening staff.
helpStep1Desc: Ensure the patient is comfortably seated in a dim room to encourage natural pupil dilation.
helpStep2Desc: Keep camera lens clean. Ensure optical disc and fovea are visible without heavy blur or reflection glare.
helpStep3Desc: AarogyaNetra uses a two-stage hierarchical model. DR Detected cases are graded from Mild to Proliferative. Uncertain results must be retested.
helpStep4Desc: Explain that screening is not a replacement for comprehensive eye care. Encourage regular blood sugar control.
